## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to

## About Us

CraneTrader.in is India’s one-stop source for buying and selling new and used crane lifting
equipment. Buyers can find crane and lifting equipment of all types, including rough-terrain,
crawler, dragline, all-terrain/hydraulic, boom truck, tower, and carry deck cranes, plus thousands
of crane parts and crane attachments. CraneTrader.in features high-quality cranes from leading
manufacturers including Grove, Link-Belt, Liebherr, Tadano, Manitowoc, Manitex, Kobelco, National,
Kato, Demag, and Broderson, among hundreds of other crane and lift manufacturers.

CraneTrader.in features a continuously updated database of equipment, parts, and attachments for
sale that come directly from dealers' inventories. The website makes it easy for buyers to browse
inventory or find specific items using the detailed search feature. CraneTrader magazine, meanwhile,
features details and full-color photos about thousands of cranes and lifting equipment for sale
worldwide. From large cranes to small specialty parts, CraneTrader magazine and CraneTrader.in are
the best avenues for finding the equipment you need or selling your inventory.

CraneTrader.in is a service of Sandhills Pacific, which is a subsidiary of Sandhills Global.
Headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska, USA, Sandhills is the company behind Machinery Trader, Truck
Paper, TractorHouse, ForestryTrader, AuctionTime.com, and many other platforms and publications
serving buyers and sellers in the construction, agriculture, trucking, and aviation industries.

#### Freight Yard Manager (FYM) is a multiplayer, interactive rail operations simulator

FYM uses a 2D overhead view of freight yards and rail-served industry using satellite images as a
background. An extensive network links maps and simulates the rail network of the US and Canada.
Each player controls individual maps, and players pass trains among maps.

Classifying cars at yards is just one of the operations that FYM offers. FYM yardmasters also run
mainline trains, load and unload unit coal and grain trains, switch cars at industrial sidings, and
load and unload intermodal cars. Cars are loaded and assigned destinations, then routed by players.
There are no fixed rules as to what players do with the cars they handle, and FYM yardmasters
cooperate to develop the simulation.

since 1999. From precision-engineered overhead cranes to robust winches, marine hoists, and stage

### All Terrain Crane: Built For Every Job Site

The All Terrain Crane (AT Crane) is designed to operate on both highways and rough construction
sites. It combines the mobility of a truck crane with the flexibility of off-road capability, making
it one of the most versatile mobile cranes available.
* Can travel on public roads at highway speed
* Capable of working on uneven or rough terrain
* Available in lifting capacities from 100 to 1200+ tons

[READ MORE ][25]
[Mobile Crane Saftey 101]

### Rough Terrain Crane: Power On Uneven Ground

A Rough Terrain Crane is a single-engine crane built for off-road construction sites, using rubber
tires and 4-wheel drive for stability on uneven ground
* Typically lifts between 20 to 130 tons
* Relies on outriggers for safe, stable lifting
* Cannot travel on highways, must be transported by trailer

[READ MORE ][26]
[Rough Terrain Crane]

### Crawler Crane: Heavy Lifting Made Stable

A Crawler Crane is a heavy-duty crane mounted on tracks instead of wheels, giving it excellent
stability without the need for outriggers. It is designed for large-scale lifting on soft or uneven
ground.
* Lifting capacity often exceeds 200 tons, up to 3000+ tons
* Moves on tracks, ideal for soft and unstable ground
* Cannot travel on roads, must be transported in parts

### All Terrain Crane: Built For Every Job Site

The All Terrain Crane (AT Crane) is designed to operate on both highways and rough construction
sites. It combines the mobility of a truck crane with the flexibility of off-road capability, making
it one of the most versatile mobile cranes available.
* Can travel on public roads at highway speed
* Capable of working on uneven or rough terrain
* Available in lifting capacities from 100 to 1200+ tons

[READ MORE ][25]
[Mobile Crane Saftey 101]

### Rough Terrain Crane: Power On Uneven Ground

A Rough Terrain Crane is a single-engine crane built for off-road construction sites, using rubber
tires and 4-wheel drive for stability on uneven ground
* Typically lifts between 20 to 130 tons
* Relies on outriggers for safe, stable lifting
* Cannot travel on highways, must be transported by trailer

[READ MORE ][26]
[Rough Terrain Crane]

### Crawler Crane: Heavy Lifting Made Stable

A Crawler Crane is a heavy-duty crane mounted on tracks instead of wheels, giving it excellent
stability without the need for outriggers. It is designed for large-scale lifting on soft or uneven
ground.
* Lifting capacity often exceeds 200 tons, up to 3000+ tons
* Moves on tracks, ideal for soft and unstable ground
* Cannot travel on roads, must be transported in parts

### How do I request a crane rental on MYCRANE?

It’s simple. Just log in, enter your project requirements (location, capacity, duration, and any
special needs), and submit your inquiry. Verified suppliers will respond with quotes, which you can
review, compare, and finalize — all on your dashboard. (Watch our explainer video to see the full
process in action.)

### Can I compare quotes from multiple suppliers?

Yes. All supplier quotes are visible on your dashboard, making it easy to compare prices,
specifications, and terms side by side. If you’d like to push for the most competitive offer, you
can also launch a **reverse auction** with shortlisted suppliers — giving them the chance to bid
against each other and lower your costs.

### How much does it cost to rent a crane?

Rental costs depend on the type of crane, lifting capacity, location, rental duration, and
mobilization/demobilization requirements. Instead of negotiating blindly, MYCRANE makes it easy:
post your inquiry, receive multiple quotes, and finalize the best option for your budget and
timeline.

## ABOUT PCM

PCM Cranes - is a trademark of the company PCM Krane&Logistik GmbH.
 

Based in Berlin, Germany, PCM cranes has been successfully operating in the global crane business
since 2001 and has earned the recognition of hundreds of customers worldwide. 
 

 

PCM Cranes offers you a wide range of used cranes between 8 and 1200 tons from world leading
manufacturers such as Liebherr, Demag, Grove, Faun, Spierings. We buy your cranes, take them in
trade, or put them on sale.

АО “Pnevmostroymashina” / PSM-HYDRAULICS
AO «Pnevmostroymashina» plant (PSM-Hydraulics® brand) was founded in 1915 and since then has been an
enterprise producing advanced high-tech products. Since 1955, the production of hydraulics has been
actively developing. Since 1970, production of axial piston machines began under a German license.
The plant has retained its own design and technology school, which makes the enterprise a Russian
flagship in the development of hydraulic systems.

PSM-Hydraulics products are used in all branches of mechanical engineering: road construction
equipment, lifting machines, mining and oil and gas production equipment, military and marine
equipment, agricultural and railway machines, technological equipment for metallurgy, energy and
other industries. More than 500 models of special equipment (crane trucks, excavators, graders,
bulldozers, combines, etc.) produced in Russia, the CIS, and countries near and far abroad are
equipped with PSM hydraulics. The products of AO «Pnevmostroymashina» are exported to 40 countries
around the world.

PSM-Hydraulics hydraulic machines are produced using modern technological equipment from global
machine tool brands.

crane performance and operating reliability.

network of over 100 official distributors.

## Every Crane Rental
## Starts with Safety and Experience.

Every TR Crane team member is OSHA certified and trained to the highest industry standards. We
prioritize safety and precision in every lift.

What size cranes are available in your fleet?

Our fleet ranges from 8-ton carry deck cranes to 240-ton all-terrain cranes, plus forklifts up to
100,000 lbs. This variety means we can handle everything from tight urban lifts to heavy industrial
projects.

What areas do you serve?

TR Crane serves clients across Cleveland, Akron, Canton, Youngstown, Warren, and throughout
Northeast Ohio. We operate within a 120-mile radius of Ravenna, OH.

Through CEI, our parent company, we can serve customers nationwide.

How do you price rentals and schedule availability?

Pricing is based on crane size, project scope, and duration. The closer we can park the crane to the
object placement, the smaller the crane we can use, therefore it will cost less. We offer
transparent quotes upfront and can often accommodate same-week availability for urgent lifts. Call
us directly to discuss rates and scheduling.

## **When Do You Need Us? Reserve A Crane Now**

Talk directly with a project planner for upfront pricing, availability,
and the right crane for your job. No delays, no guesswork.

[Request a Free Bid][34]
**From 8 Tons to 240 Tons**

## **Cranes for Every Lift**

Our fleet covers the full spectrum: carry decks for tight spaces, boom trucks for mid-size jobs,
rough terrains for demanding sites, and all-terrains for the heaviest lifts. Whatever your project,
we have the right crane ready.
* **Carry Deck Cranes (8–20 Ton)**
* **Boom Trucks (25–45 Ton)**
* **Rough Terrain Cranes (30–75 Ton)**
* **All-Terrain Cranes (75–240 Ton)**
* **Forklifts (60,000–100,000 lbs)**

[View Full Fleet][35]

## Who is TR Crane?

When you choose TR Crane, you can trust that you’re getting the best crane services available in
Northeast Ohio. Our experienced crane operators and signalers work closely with you to ensure your
job is completed safely, on time, and on budget. Whether you need HVAC lifts, truss lifts, steel
erection lifts, or any other type of lift — we’ve got you covered.

### **Our Experience, Backed by CEI Crane & Rigging**

**How is TR Crane connected to CEI Crane & Rigging?**

TR Crane is a wholly owned subsidiary of CEI Crane & Rigging, a leading crane and rigging provider
with over 60 years of experience.

As part of the CEI family, TR Crane has access to an extensive fleet ranging from 8-ton carry deck
cranes to 240-ton all-terrain cranes, plus forklifts up to 100,000 lbs.

This partnership allows us to handle jobs of any size — from local HVAC lifts to complex, heavy
industrial projects — while maintaining the responsiveness and personal service of a local team.

### CARRY DECK CRANE

[ See Carry Deck Cranes ][38]

Carry Deck cranes are mobile cranes that feature a quick setup and rotation but are limited in
capacity. They are ideal for applications requiring a compact, low-profile crane that will clear
overhead obstructions and maneuver in tight spaces. We have carry deck cranes from 8.5 ton to 15 ton
in our inventory. 

Lifting Capacity up to 15 tons

[rough terrain crane for sale or rent]

Rough terrain cranes are designed to operate on off-road and “rough” applications and surfaces. They
can be moved around a job site easily and are usually less expensive to transport. Our rough terrain
cranes fall in 2 categories dependent on the requirement of the project: 30 ton to 70 ton for
lighter jobs and 75 ton to 130 ton for heavier jobs.

Lifting Capacity up to 130 tons

### CRAWLER CRANE

[crawler crane rental and sales]
[ See Crawler Cranes ][41]

Crawler cranes use tracks instead of rubber wheels. Crawler cranes are optimal for sites with soft
terrain by dispersing the load weights over greater surface area. They can move around site and
perform each lift with little set-up since the crane is stable on its tracks.

Lifting Capacity up to 250 tons

## About Us

CraneTrader.in is India’s one-stop source for buying and selling new and used crane lifting
equipment. Buyers can find crane and lifting equipment of all types, including rough-terrain,
crawler, dragline, all-terrain/hydraulic, boom truck, tower, and carry deck cranes, plus thousands
of crane parts and crane attachments. CraneTrader.in features high-quality cranes from leading
manufacturers including Grove, Link-Belt, Liebherr, Tadano, Manitowoc, Manitex, Kobelco, National,
Kato, Demag, and Broderson, among hundreds of other crane and lift manufacturers.

CraneTrader.in features a continuously updated database of equipment, parts, and attachments for
sale that come directly from dealers' inventories. The website makes it easy for buyers to browse
inventory or find specific items using the detailed search feature. CraneTrader magazine, meanwhile,
features details and full-color photos about thousands of cranes and lifting equipment for sale
worldwide. From large cranes to small specialty parts, CraneTrader magazine and CraneTrader.in are
the best avenues for finding the equipment you need or selling your inventory.

CraneTrader.in is a service of Sandhills Pacific, which is a subsidiary of Sandhills Global.
Headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska, USA, Sandhills is the company behind Machinery Trader, Truck
Paper, TractorHouse, ForestryTrader, AuctionTime.com, and many other platforms and publications

#### Freight Yard Manager (FYM) is a multiplayer, interactive rail operations simulator

FYM uses a 2D overhead view of freight yards and rail-served industry using satellite images as a
background. An extensive network links maps and simulates the rail network of the US and Canada.
Each player controls individual maps, and players pass trains among maps.

Classifying cars at yards is just one of the operations that FYM offers. FYM yardmasters also run
mainline trains, load and unload unit coal and grain trains, switch cars at industrial sidings, and
load and unload intermodal cars. Cars are loaded and assigned destinations, then routed by players.
There are no fixed rules as to what players do with the cars they handle, and FYM yardmasters
cooperate to develop the simulation.

### All Terrain Crane: Built For Every Job Site

The All Terrain Crane (AT Crane) is designed to operate on both highways and rough construction
sites. It combines the mobility of a truck crane with the flexibility of off-road capability, making
it one of the most versatile mobile cranes available.
* Can travel on public roads at highway speed
* Capable of working on uneven or rough terrain
* Available in lifting capacities from 100 to 1200+ tons

[READ MORE ][25]
[Mobile Crane Saftey 101]

### Rough Terrain Crane: Power On Uneven Ground

A Rough Terrain Crane is a single-engine crane built for off-road construction sites, using rubber
tires and 4-wheel drive for stability on uneven ground
* Typically lifts between 20 to 130 tons
* Relies on outriggers for safe, stable lifting
* Cannot travel on highways, must be transported by trailer

[READ MORE ][26]
[Rough Terrain Crane]

### Crawler Crane: Heavy Lifting Made Stable

A Crawler Crane is a heavy-duty crane mounted on tracks instead of wheels, giving it excellent
stability without the need for outriggers. It is designed for large-scale lifting on soft or uneven
ground.
* Lifting capacity often exceeds 200 tons, up to 3000+ tons
* Moves on tracks, ideal for soft and unstable ground
* Cannot travel on roads, must be transported in parts

### How do I request a crane rental on MYCRANE?

It’s simple. Just log in, enter your project requirements (location, capacity, duration, and any

process in action.)

### Can I compare quotes from multiple suppliers?

Yes. All supplier quotes are visible on your dashboard, making it easy to compare prices,
specifications, and terms side by side. If you’d like to push for the most competitive offer, you
can also launch a **reverse auction** with shortlisted suppliers — giving them the chance to bid
against each other and lower your costs.

mobilization/demobilization requirements. Instead of negotiating blindly, MYCRANE makes it easy:

## ABOUT PCM

PCM Cranes - is a trademark of the company PCM Krane&Logistik GmbH.
 

Based in Berlin, Germany, PCM cranes has been successfully operating in the global crane business
since 2001 and has earned the recognition of hundreds of customers worldwide. 
 

 

PCM Cranes offers you a wide range of used cranes between 8 and 1200 tons from world leading
manufacturers such as Liebherr, Demag, Grove, Faun, Spierings. We buy your cranes, take them in
trade, or put them on sale.

АО “Pnevmostroymashina” / PSM-HYDRAULICS
AO «Pnevmostroymashina» plant (PSM-Hydraulics® brand) was founded in 1915 and since then has been an
enterprise producing advanced high-tech products. Since 1955, the production of hydraulics has been
actively developing. Since 1970, production of axial piston machines began under a German license.
The plant has retained its own design and technology school, which makes the enterprise a Russian
flagship in the development of hydraulic systems.

PSM-Hydraulics products are used in all branches of mechanical engineering: road construction
equipment, lifting machines, mining and oil and gas production equipment, military and marine
equipment, agricultural and railway machines, technological equipment for metallurgy, energy and
other industries. More than 500 models of special equipment (crane trucks, excavators, graders,
bulldozers, combines, etc.) produced in Russia, the CIS, and countries near and far abroad are
equipped with PSM hydraulics. The products of AO «Pnevmostroymashina» are exported to 40 countries
around the world.

PSM-Hydraulics hydraulic machines are produced using modern technological equipment from global
machine tool brands.

АО “Pnevmostroymashina” / PSM-HYDRAULICS
AO «Pnevmostroymashina» plant (PSM-Hydraulics® brand) was founded in 1915 and since then has been an
enterprise producing advanced high-tech products. Since 1955, the production of hydraulics has been
actively developing. Since 1970, production of axial piston machines began under a German license.
The plant has retained its own design and technology school, which makes the enterprise a Russian
flagship in the development of hydraulic systems.

PSM-Hydraulics products are used in all branches of mechanical engineering: road construction
equipment, lifting machines, mining and oil and gas production equipment, military and marine
equipment, agricultural and railway machines, technological equipment for metallurgy, energy and
other industries. More than 500 models of special equipment (crane trucks, excavators, graders,
bulldozers, combines, etc.) produced in Russia, the CIS, and countries near and far abroad are
equipped with PSM hydraulics. The products of AO «Pnevmostroymashina» are exported to 40 countries
around the world.

PSM-Hydraulics hydraulic machines are produced using modern technological equipment from global
machine tool brands.

**Hydraulic Crane Specialists is a full-service crane rental company that offers turnkey solutions
for your large or small project. Services offered include: crane rental, lift planning, rigging
services, and transportation services. **

your lift. With a wide range of capabilities including: transportation solutions, rigging rentals,
operated and bare crane rentals, CAD lift plans, experienced certified personnel, and 24-hour

## Every Crane Rental
## Starts with Safety and Experience.

Every TR Crane team member is OSHA certified and trained to the highest industry standards. We
prioritize safety and precision in every lift.

What size cranes are available in your fleet?

Our fleet ranges from 8-ton carry deck cranes to 240-ton all-terrain cranes, plus forklifts up to
100,000 lbs. This variety means we can handle everything from tight urban lifts to heavy industrial
projects.

What areas do you serve?

TR Crane serves clients across Cleveland, Akron, Canton, Youngstown, Warren, and throughout
Northeast Ohio. We operate within a 120-mile radius of Ravenna, OH.

Through CEI, our parent company, we can serve customers nationwide.

How do you price rentals and schedule availability?

Pricing is based on crane size, project scope, and duration. The closer we can park the crane to the
object placement, the smaller the crane we can use, therefore it will cost less. We offer
transparent quotes upfront and can often accommodate same-week availability for urgent lifts. Call
us directly to discuss rates and scheduling.
